**Done.** A repeat of the same `key` within 5 minutes now drops.

Only a notification we actually sent starts the window. Drops don't slide it forward, so a flapping alert settles into one delivery every 5 minutes.

```
600 dup first   -> push
602 dup +2min   -> (dropped)
604 other key   -> push
605 dup +5min   -> push
```

Queued notifications count as sent, so quiet-hour repeats drop too.

The replay drops 99 of 900 now. No errors.

`node verify.js` also passes: `OK the router matches the rules as they finally stood`.
